movement_profile.footwork: tapping out the rhythm with feet

signature_moves.description: The two lines of dancers approach and cross each other.
signature_moves.name: Line Crossing

music_profile.sound_description: A blend of Spanish-derived harmonies and Afro-Caribbean syncopation, featuring a prominent cuatro and rhythmic percussion from the bongó and güiro.

basic_steps: Form two parallel lines with partners facing each other.
Step forward to approach the opposite line.
Tap the rhythm with the feet at prescribed intervals.
teaching.formation: Two lines of dancers facing each other.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly structure with complex rhythmic footwork.
